title: Scoreboard CheckList
description: A scoreboard checklist you can use on multiplayer servers or in singleplayer or if you just want to toggle the scoreboard of the server
body:
Scoreboard Checklist: you can use it as checklist or just to toggle off any server Scoreboard

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/lHTg4dCPLV0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Its a super lightweight checklist mod that allows you to display interactive checklists directly on the player's scoreboard. Perfect for tutorials, quests, tasks, objectives, and progression tracking.
